desc:
✨ WELCOME TO THE CICAVERSE ✨

📣 Claim the New Cica Triple Black Shoes TODAY in the CICASTORE so you can gain a 2x multiplier on coins earned in all mini games!

🏟  Step inside the Clarks Stadium and get set for the sports tournament of a lifetime! 
👟 Take on your friends in the CICAVERSE and grab the highest scores! 
🚲 Show off slick BMX jumps and breakdance skills! 
🏃‍♂️ Parkour to the finish line, cheered along by real-life athlete inspired NPCs on your journey.

🌟 Even more awesome swag!
💪 Drop into the Clarks virtual store to power up your kicks
💯 Super-charge your CICA experience with the coolest customizations at the CICASTORE.
👐 Wings made from shoelaces? Looking flyyy! 
💨 An all-gold jetpack? Consider your play powered up.
